verdict.rationale: Most card lifecycle actions (create, activate, suspend, close, update balance account, transaction rules, disputes) are exposed via API per docs, but several operations are documented as Customer Area-only: configuring relayed authorisation webhooks (docs-6), viewing card payments (docs-13, docs-20), and uploading dispute evidence zips (docs-8, pilot). No OpenAPI spec was found to confirm full parity (probe-3). missing for 10: API equivalents for relayed-authorisation webhook configuration, payment viewing, and dispute evidence upload; independent confirmation of full API/UI parity.
